$comment: Data for scripts/ci-projects.mjs, which finds every buildable example project from its manifest
(package.json, requirements.txt, Gemfile, go.mod, pom.xml, *.csproj, Cargo.toml, mix.exs, composer.json, ...).
shared: changes under these paths check every project on a pull request.
ignore: changed files ending in one of these never trigger a check.
images: Docker image per toolchain; {version} is filled from the manifest (engines.node, go.mod, Java release,
TargetFramework), or from defaults when the manifest doesn't pin one.
projects: per-project exceptions, with why saying the reason. install/check replace the default commands, image the default image.
knownFailure: the check still runs but may fail without failing the workflow; say why and remove it once fixed.

laravel-elasticemail-examples.why: The files drop into a fresh Laravel project, so there is no artisan for composer's post-autoload-dump script.

redwoodjs-elasticemail-examples/javascri.why: Redwood is a Yarn workspace and its CLI expects Yarn. The node image ships Yarn 1, which unlike the Yarn 4 the README uses enforces engines; current @whatwg-node deps want Node 22.15+ while Redwood 8 declares 20.x.

redwoodjs-elasticemail-examples/typescri.why: Redwood is a Yarn workspace and its CLI expects Yarn. The node image ships Yarn 1, which unlike the Yarn 4 the README uses enforces engines; current @whatwg-node deps want Node 22.15+ while Redwood 8 declares 20.x.

serverless-elasticemail-examples/netlify.why: netlify-cli's postinstall (jwa -> buffer-equal-constant-time) uses SlowBuffer, which Node 25+ removed.
